message.content: On September 16th, 2026, WolfgangSchulz suggested incorporating improvisational solos into their practice sessions. He proposed this idea because he believed it could significantly enhance their jazz fusion skills and make the practice sessions more enjoyable and creative. Additionally, WolfgangSchulz expressed optimism that the improvisation would challenge them and aid in their growth as musicians. LiHua enthusiastically supported this suggestion, agreeing that it would be fun and challenging, and they looked forward to trying it out. Yuriko Yamamoto also shared her excitement about the idea, noting that it would allow them to showcase their individual talents and make the practice time more engaging and spontaneous.
